recipe.name: Mez & Mace
recipe.description: A striking balance of rich agave smoke and warm, woody spice, highlighting aromatic mace alongside fiery mezcal.
steps: Add mezcal, house-made mace cordial, and fresh lime juice into a shaker filled with ice.
Shake until thoroughly chilled and diluted.
Fine strain into a chilled coupe glass.
recipe.garnish: A piece of whole mace blade floated on top
recipe.serving: Served chilled in a stemmed coupe glass
